rules.content:
`comment("Splunk SPL for Counterfeit/Non-Delivery Fraud Network Detection")`
`comment("Detects organized merchant fraud via disputes, drops, pricing, and account age")`
index=flame_ecommerce sourcetype=flame:merchant_monitoring
  (merchant_type="marketplace_seller" OR merchant_type="ecommerce_merchant" OR merchant_type="auction_seller")
| eval seller_age_days = round((now() - strptime(seller_account_creation_date, "%Y-%m-%d")) / 86400, 0)
| eval high_dispute = if(dispute_rate_pct >= 2.0 AND dispute_count_30d >= 10, 1, 0)
| eval drop_location = if(shipping_address_drop_flag="true" AND shipping_address_cluster_count >= 5, 1, 0)
| eval below_market = if(avg_price_vs_market_ratio <= 0.70, 1, 0)
| eval new_high_vol = if(seller_age_days <= 90 AND transaction_count_30d >= 50, 1, 0)
| eval indicator_count = high_dispute + drop_location + below_market + new_high_vol
| where (high_dispute=1 AND below_market=1)
     OR (high_dispute=1 AND new_high_vol=1)
     OR (drop_location=1 AND new_high_vol=1)
     OR (below_market=1 AND drop_location=1)
| eval risk_score = case(
    indicator_count >= 4, "critical",
    indicator_count >= 3, "high",
    indicator_count >= 2, "medium",
    1=1, "low")
| table merchant_id, merchant_name, seller_account_creation_date, seller_age_days,
        transaction_count_30d, total_sales_30d, dispute_count_30d, dispute_rate_pct,
        avg_price_vs_market_ratio, shipping_address_drop_flag,
        shipping_address_cluster_count, indicator_count, risk_score
| sort - indicator_count, - dispute_rate_pct
rules.title: DL-0176: Organized Counterfeit Goods and Non-Delivery Fraud Network — High Dispute Merchant Accounts with Drop Location Clustering and Below-Market Pricing (SPLUNK)
